name: Differentiable Forward Projection (Mesh)
definition: A differentiable forward projection module that computes 2D projections of 3D triangle meshes by applying view transformations, perspective projection, and rasterization, supporting both parallel and cone-beam geometries.
summary: Differentiable Forward Projection (Mesh) computes differentiable 3D mesh projections onto 2D detectors by operating directly on mesh topology with a custom CUDA rasterizer to enable gradient backpropagation.
